label: rnwpp inputs span
definition: R-NWPP corrected backcast inputs 2019-2025 (vintage EIA-860, measured plant heat rates, CAMPD short-coal + partial outages, mid-vintage exit carry; 2020 data-blocked)
market_story: COAL: the fleet is the coal that actually operated each year (Colstrip 1-2 and Centralia 1 through 2019, Jim Bridger 1-2 on coal through 2023, North Valmy 1 through 2024), each at its own measured CEMS heat rate; regulated take-or-pay coal runs baseload because its owners commit it on contract, not on the spot price. CT_PEAKER: peakers are priced at their measured CEMS heat rates (10.7-11.1 MMBtu/MWh, not the 8.9 class value), so they clear only in the hours scarcity actually calls them. CC_REGULAR: combined cycles set the margin behind hydro; the model's shortfall against EIA-923 is the open demand-basis gap (EIA-930 under-books PGE/BPAT/PACW gas), not a CC offer effect. OUTAGES: measured CAMPD full, short (1-5 day) coal and partial-derate windows remove capacity when the units were physically unavailable.
